metadata.title: Smooth Quasi--Einstein Lifts of Locally Embeddable Three-Dimensional CR Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove a $C^\infty$ analogue of the real-analytic quasi--Einstein lifting theorem of Hill, Lewandowski and Nurowski \cite[Theorem~2.5]{HLN2008}. Every smooth, locally CR-embeddable, strictly pseudoconvex three-dimensional CR manifold admits, for each real cosmological constant, a local smooth Lorentzian quasi--Einstein lift whose null congruence is geodesic, shearfree and twisting and whose Weyl tensor has Petrov type~$\mathrm{II}$ or $\mathrm{D}$. The result extends local lifting beyond the Sasakian setting of the global constructions in \cite{GSS2020} and the local results in \cite{GGS2026}. The proof establishes smooth local solvability of the reduced semilinear contact equation by combining an $L^\infty$ contraction with subelliptic regularity.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 证明光滑、局部 CR 可嵌入的三维严格伪凸 CR 流形，对每个实宇宙常数均有局部 Lorentz 拟 Einstein 提升，其零同余为测地、无剪切且扭转。
analysis.breakthrough: 将原有实解析提升定理推广到 C∞ 范畴，并超出 Sasakian 的局部情形。
analysis.limitations: 要求局部 CR 可嵌入；仅为局部提升，不能推断全局存在或任意 CR 流形可提升。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: CR 几何与 Lorentz 特殊结构的有效局部桥梁。
